reviews.title: Durable and reliable
reviews.comment: For a small form factor, low TDP system you're really threading the needle of size, power, noise level, and heat. This is a very weird size category for power supply, so you're going to be limited on the venn diagram of "power supplies that fit the case," "reasonable prices" and "power supplies that are from. Reliable brands." Given that a bad power supply can literally burn your house down - reliable brand is a non negotiate factor for me. It was a easy install. Definitely value for money.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer
